releaseName: Lokify v1.3.8 – Satellite Report & Category Fix
releaseNotes:
• Foreign Key Fix: Resolved issues_category_id_fkey constraint by mapping UI categories safely to validated database categories with auto-retry.
• Input First Layout: Inputs (Title, Category, Description, Contact details) now appear first on Report an Issue page.
• Dedicated Satellite View: Report page map features high-resolution aerial Satellite imagery with street and landmark overlays.
• Maintained Play Protect unharmful security profile.
